g.text: * Channel attention in (c): backbone only; omitted in neck. Cₕ = C_out / 2. The two CSP branches are learned projections, not a raw channel split.

g.text: Panels (a) and (c) are placed at different network locations; they are not a universal serial chain. All arrows follow the current implementation.
